name: Jan B.
headline: CDTM | 3x Founder | Game Dev, Software Engineer, Product Owner, UX Designer | Pre-Seed Tech Investor
summary:
I had the luck to learn coding starting at age nine, some 30 years ago. During school, I worked as a developer and started three companies before finishing my Bachelor's degree in computer science—but in all fairness, that took me 27 semesters to complete.

In my startups, I held positions in engineering and product. I still probably do my best work in engineering, but my true passion has never been that of a technician—I love finding viable, desirable, feasible solutions to real world problems, for real people. Thus, I have a passion for UX and business. I want my work to have an impact—and create a healthy profit.

Since 2020, I also work as an investor with the worlds most audacious founders, who set out to change the world.

company.name: Klang Games
company.tagline: Klang is a game & entertainment studio exploring the future of humanity through various forms of media.
company.description:
Klang is an independent game development studio based in Berlin. It was founded by three Icelanders in the spring of 2013.

In July 2015, Klang launched its first project, ReRunners: Race for the World, for iOS and Android devices, which was extremely well-received by both the gaming press and the gaming community.

Now, Klang is working on its next project, Seed, a simulation MMO utilizing SpatialOS technology.
